Questions

Good to know.

How many guests can you hold?

The Champagne Room holds up to 600 guests, the Conti Room up to 200, and the Holiday Room up to 125.

What cuisines do you offer?

Cuisines from around the world, including Continental, Italian, Spanish, West Indian, Caribbean and Ethnic menus.

Will you help us plan?

Yes. Our wedding coordinators help with every step, from the chapel ceremony and officiant to flowers, limousines, photography, video and DJ entertainment.

Can we bring our own vendors?

Yes. We can tailor your package or work with vendors you bring in.

Can we taste the food first?

Yes. We encourage you to come in for a food tasting with our chefs.
